16124.name: rough Hearth Shard
16124.description: Dropped by every monster on Floor 1's hunting grounds.

16119.name: cut Hearth Shard
16119.description: Dropped on Floor 1's harder grounds: Wolf Copse, Reedmarsh, Thornsnap Hollow, Shard Fields, the Bandit Road, the Old Quarry, and their caves.

16120.name: flawless Hearth Shard
16120.description: Dropped by Floor 1's elites (Grey Alpha, Bandit Captain), in the Old Watchtower and on group grounds.

16122.name: rough Highland Shard
16122.description: Dropped by every monster on Floor 2's hunting grounds.

16121.name: cut Highland Shard
16121.description: Dropped on Floor 2's harder grounds and caves.

16127.name: flawless Highland Shard
16127.description: Dropped by Floor 2's elites and on its group grounds.

28650.name: Mastery Respec Scroll
28650.description: Use it to choose your style again: your Mastery points stay. Sold only in the shop; one use.

5805.name: Chronicle Cup
5805.description: Awarded for finishing a season's Spire Chronicle. It looks best on a shelf in your house.

9636.name: Beacon Ember
9636.description: Light a fire bowl of a town's Beacon with it: +5% experience and loot for everyone on that floor for an hour. Dropped by field bosses, hidden beasts, and sometimes elites and apex monsters.
